name: Urban Ecosystem — 20-Year Resource & Growth Dynamics
description: Illustrative system-dynamics model of a 10,000-resident city with three power stations, two water reservoirs, finite regional resources, and evolving infrastructure capacity over 20 years. Executable fully offline without an external API key.

stocks.name: Population
stocks.description: Total active residents living within municipal boundaries.

stocks.name: Water Reserves
stocks.description: Combined stored freshwater across two municipal reservoirs.

stocks.name: Available Resources
stocks.description: Accessible regional construction, fuel, and industrial material reserves.

stocks.name: Infrastructure Capacity
stocks.description: Combined housing, transit, grid distribution, and sanitation capacity.

parameters.name: Base Birth Rate
parameters.description: Annual baseline per-capita birth and net-migration growth factor under adequate infrastructure.

parameters.name: Base Death Rate
parameters.description: Annual baseline per-capita mortality and out-migration factor under normal conditions.

parameters.name: Power Stations
parameters.description: Number of active municipal power generation stations.

parameters.name: Output per Station
parameters.description: Sustained average generation capacity per power station.

parameters.name: Electricity Demand per Capita
parameters.description: Average combined residential and commercial electrical load per resident.

parameters.name: Water Reservoirs
parameters.description: Number of watershed-fed reservoirs supplying the city.

parameters.name: Annual Inflow per Reservoir
parameters.description: Average yearly rainfall and watershed recharge per reservoir.

parameters.name: Water Usage per Capita
parameters.description: Annual municipal, industrial, and domestic water demand per resident.

parameters.name: Resource Use per Capita
parameters.description: Annual material and fuel consumption per resident.

parameters.name: Resource Replenishment Rate
parameters.description: Annual sustainable supply and regional trade inflow of materials.

parameters.name: Infrastructure Investment Rate
parameters.description: Annual fractional expansion of infrastructure when material reserves are healthy.

parameters.name: Infrastructure Depreciation Rate
parameters.description: Annual physical aging and wear rate of urban infrastructure.

auxiliaries.name: Electricity Production
auxiliaries.description: Effective generation output across active power stations, derated if regional fuel/material reserves drop critically low.

auxiliaries.name: Electricity Demand
auxiliaries.description: Total urban electrical load driven by population size.

auxiliaries.name: Electricity Balance
auxiliaries.description: Net grid reserve margin (positive indicates surplus; negative indicates deficit/brownouts).

auxiliaries.name: Infrastructure Load Ratio
auxiliaries.description: Ratio of active residents to available infrastructure capacity (>1.0 indicates overcrowding).

auxiliaries.name: Water Security Index
auxiliaries.description: Years of municipal water demand currently held in reservoir storage.

auxiliaries.name: Urban Stress Factor
auxiliaries.equation: max(0, crowding_ratio - 1.0) * 0.015 + (0.014 if electricity_balance < 0 else 0.0) + (0.022 if water_security_index < 0.4 else 0.0)
auxiliaries.description: Additional annual mortality/out-migration pressure caused by overcrowding, power deficits, or water scarcity.

flows.name: Births & Net Inflow
flows.description: Annual resident additions moderated by infrastructure availability.

flows.name: Deaths & Stress Outflow
flows.description: Annual resident departures combining baseline mortality with resource/grid stress.

flows.name: Water Inflow
flows.description: Combined annual watershed recharge into municipal reservoirs.

flows.name: Water Consumption
flows.description: Annual water withdrawal bounded by physically available reserves.

flows.name: Resource Replenishment
flows.description: Annual material and fuel replenishment into city reserves.

flows.name: Resource Consumption
flows.description: Annual material consumption from residents and power station operations.

flows.name: Infrastructure Expansion
flows.description: Annual capacity additions limited by available construction resources.

constraints.label: Electricity grid entered deficit (demand exceeded production)
Water reserve buffer fell below 6 months of demand
Regional material reserves dropped below 30,000 tons

assumptions.statement: All starting stocks (10,000 residents, 2.4M m3 water, 150k tons materials) and rates are illustrative educational baselines, not calibrated to a specific municipality.
Annual reservoir inflow is held constant without seasonal rainfall oscillations or multi-year drought shocks.
Power station count remains constant throughout the 20-year run unless modified in an alternative experiment.
Power deficits, crowding above 1.0x capacity, and water buffers under 0.4 years linearly increase the combined death and out-migration rate.
